messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the postmortem retro for last week's intermittent infra degradation. Who's available next Tue/Wed?
Eli: Either works for me, prefer Wed afternoon.
Sasha: Wed +1. Need to review the timeline beforehand.
André: Wed works. I can own the mitigations section.
Jin: Tue morning is better for me, but I can shift if needed.
Clara: Wed afternoon suits me too. Happy to take scribe if no one else volunteers.
Priya: OK looks like Wed wins. Two quick asks before I create the invite: (1) volunteers for agenda sections, (2) any prework we want people to read.
Eli: I can do "Timeline & evidence" (logs, query traces).
Sasha: I'll do "Impact & customer comms" + prepare the initial list of affected routes.
André: I'll cover "Mitigations & runbook gaps" and bring proposed quick fixes.
Jin: I can run the action triage table and propose owners.
Clara: I'll scribe and capture action items.
Priya: Awesome. Draft agenda (please react if you want time changes):
```
Agenda (45m total)
- 5m: TL;DR + goals for this retro
- 15m: Timeline & evidence (Eli)
- 10m: Impact & customer comms (Sasha)
- 10m: Mitigations & runbook gaps (André)
- 5m: Action triage + owners (Jin)
- 5m: Retro feedback + close (Priya/Clara)
```
Sasha: Can we make timeline 20m? there are a few unclear gaps I want to point out.
Priya: Fine to extend timeline to 20, cut mitigations to 5. Thumbs? :thumbsup: for 20/5 split
Eli: :thumbsup:
André: :thumbsup:
Jin: :thumbsup:
Clara: :thumbsup:
Priya: Cool — final agenda updated. Prework: please add any logs, ticket links, or screenshots to the retro doc before EOD Mon. I'll paste doc link in thread. Also add any specific prompts you want run against the traces (e.g., latency histograms).
Priya: Tentative invite: Wed 3:00–3:45pm PT. Who must be on the call? I propose oncall, runtime leads, infra, support rep, and the owners above. Callouts?
Eli: Add the API platform owner (Zoe) — she had a related config change.
Sasha: +1 Zoe. Also send to customer success for comms context.
André: Please include the deploy log snippet for the offending change in prework.
Jin: I'll prepare the action tracker template (CSV) and attach in the doc.
Priya: Cool — volunteers/fallbacks noted. If anyone wants to swap sections, say now. Otherwise I’ll create invite, add the doc, and tag everyone.
Clara: I can run a 5-min retrospective survey at the end (quick Google form) for async feedback.
Priya: Perfect. I’ll create calendar invite and post doc link in this thread in ~10m.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Retro — infra intermittent degradation" Wed 3:00pm PT. Invite: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123
Priya: Invite out, doc link: https://docs.example/redwood/retro-infra-1852001200 — please add prework items by EOD Mon.
Eli: Adding logs now.
Sasha: Uploading customer impact notes.
André: Adding proposed runbook edits.
Jin: Action tracker attached.
Clara: I'll prep the scribe template and drop into the doc.
Priya: Thanks everyone — we'll recap action owners during the retro and follow up with a short action status check one week after.
Eli: Sounds good.
Sasha: Thanks!
André: See you Wed.
Jin: Thanks all.
Clara: :wave:
